Blunt Sword.desc: A heavy iron blade. Increases physical power.

Bow.desc: A flexible longbow. Increases attack speed.

Chestplate.desc: Reinforced steel plating. Grants bonus defense.

Mana Crystal.desc: A shimmering blue crystal that accelerates mana regeneration.

Magic Orb.desc: A swirling sphere of arcane energy. Boosts magic power.

Cloak.desc: A shadowy enchanted cloak. Provides magic resistance.

Dagger.desc: A sharp, lightweight blade. Increases critical chance.

Belt.desc: A sturdy leather belt. Grants bonus health.

Sovereign's Edge.desc: A royal blade forged from pure strength.

Sage's Spear.desc: A balanced spear for the warrior-scholar.

Aether Blade.desc: A blade infused with both physical and magical energy.

Colossus Sunderer.desc: A massive weapon that strikes with incredible speed.

Vampiric Greatsword.desc: A dark sword offering power and magic protection.

Ruinous Edge.desc: A cruel blade that finds weak points.

Hero's Crest.desc: A champion's emblem for strength and vitality.

Aura of Clarity.desc: Twin mana crystals creating a wellspring of energy.

Archmage's Codex.desc: A tome of immense arcane knowledge.

Stormcharged Bow.desc: A bow crackling with electric energy.

Chalice of Justice.desc: A holy chalice granting clarity and precision.

Berserker's Glaive.desc: A wild weapon channeling fury into rapid strikes.

Crown of Valor.desc: A crown for battle-mages at the front lines.

Static Ward.desc: An arcane barrier deflecting hostile magic.

Burning Grimoire.desc: A forbidden tome of fire magic.

Marksman's Longbow.desc: A masterwork bow firing at blistering speeds.

Titan's Resolve.desc: Speed and endurance of a fortress.

Thornmail Vest.desc: A fortress of spikes and steel.

Sunfire Cape.desc: A burning cape granting armor and vitality.

Dragon's Scale.desc: A scale from an ancient dragon.

Mithril Cloak.desc: A lightweight cloak of incredible magic resistance.

Evenshroud.desc: Dark fabric balancing protection and endurance.

Shattering Hammer.desc: A hammer crushing armor and fortifying.

Relic Shard.desc: A fragment of an ancient relic. Empowers the bearer with residual age-old energy.
Relic Shard.effect: Permanently grants +25 max HP to the equipped unit.

Timeworn Amulet.desc: An amulet that has witnessed centuries of battle. It shields the wearer from harm.
Timeworn Amulet.effect: Permanently grants +8 DEF and +8 MDEF to the equipped unit.

Crown of Eons.desc: A crown worn by ancient sovereigns. It commands the flow of battle.
Crown of Eons.effect: Permanently grants +15% Damage Amplification to the equipped unit.

Scepter of Ages.desc: A scepter containing the condensed wisdom of forgotten eras.
Scepter of Ages.effect: Permanently grants +20% ATK and +20% AP to the equipped unit.

Ark of Eternity.desc: The ultimate relic — a fragment of creation itself.
Ark of Eternity.effect: Permanently grants +500 HP, +20 DEF, +20 MDEF, and +25% Damage Amp to the equipped unit.

Uxtil's Leap.desc: A shimmering leap of ancient energy. Greatly accelerates mana.
Uxtil's Leap.effect: +5 Mana Regen/sec. On Tomb Raider: mana cost reduced to 0/45.

Darkest Light.desc: Dark protective light that feeds on enemy attention.
Darkest Light.effect: +40 DEF, +40 MDEF, +1% dmg reduction per attacker. On Stone Protector: taunts 3 farthest enemies too.

True Uxtil's Leap.desc: The perfected leap — pure accelerated energy.
True Uxtil's Leap.effect: +50% ATK, +5 Mana Regen/sec. On Ancient units: -20 max mana.

True Darkest Light.desc: The perfected dark light that commands enemy focus.
True Darkest Light.effect: 4% dmg reduction per attacker. 4 farthest enemies target wearer, -10% their damage.

Helios's Cascade.desc: A cascade of ancient solar power. Burns through all defenses.
Helios's Cascade.effect: +90% AP. Damage inflicts -40% DEF/MDEF & -33% healing. On Runecarver: skills activate Sunlight (50% AP to all enemies).

Pinnacle.desc: The ultimate ancient relic. Absolute power.
Pinnacle.effect: +10000 HP, 99% dmg reduction, 50 mana regen/sec. Battle start: all enemies become 1-star. Skill use: Annihilate (100% max HP of 3 targets).

Lesser Duplicator.desc: A magical device that duplicates a unit from your bench.
Lesser Duplicator.effect: Place on a 1/2/3-cost bench unit to spawn a 1-star copy.
